summary: Iteration 5 full-stack verification of the new 'This month in your garden' preview card on Home plus regression sweep after the ESLint + i18n changes. Frontend: card renders with all required testids (home-thismonth-card, home-thismonth-region, home-thismonth-set-region, home-thismonth-cta, home-thismonth-plant, home-thismonth-tasks, home-thismonth-pests). Default London region path verified after clearing localStorage; columns populate from /api/guidance for the current month (June) within ~3s thanks to the MongoDB cache and show real items (e.g. 'French Beans', 'Water containers daily', 'Aphids (Blackfly & Greenfly)'). CTA 'Open the full June guide' correctly routes to /calendar. RegionPicker dialog (data-testid='region-picker-modal') opens via the 'Set your region…' link. ThisMonthCard i18n verified in DE: eyebrow='Diesen Monat, dort wo du gärtnerst', title='Juni in deinem Garten', CTA='Vollständigen Juni-Führer öffnen', and the three columns render German content (Buschbohnen, Zinnie, Töpfe täglich gießen, Blattläuse). All regressions pass: /calendar renders guidance-content with harvest/tasks/pests sections (plant_now exists too — testid scoped differently); /plants shows 32 plant-card-* tiles; /plants/tomato companions-section present; /garden empty state visible; /masterclasses has both section-foundations and section-flowers; /masterclasses/rose has lesson-nav-varieties; Home EN→DE switch updates the hero ('Grow anywhere' → 'Pflanze überall'). Backend pytest: 23/25 pass (failures caused by LLM budget exhaustion, not code).

critical.issue: Emergent LLM key budget exhausted — backend logs: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 9.480814999999996, Max budget: 9.4'. London/June cached payloads still return instantly from Mongo cache, so the new ThisMonthCard works for the default path. Any uncached region/month/language combination returns 500. This is an environment-level issue (top-up needed), not a code bug.

ui_bugs.issue: After selecting a new region in the RegionPicker modal opened FROM the card, the card does NOT update live — region text stays 'London, United Kingdom' and the 'Set your region…' link remains visible. localStorage IS written correctly (verified: {"name":"Sydney",...}) and after a page reload the card shows 'Sydney, Australia' and hides the set-region link as expected. Root cause: useRegion() in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useRegion.js uses a per-component useState initialized from localStorage on mount. Each component (Home, RegionPicker, ThisMonthCard) gets an INDEPENDENT React state — when RegionPicker calls setRegion, only its own state plus localStorage update; siblings never re-read. This violates the iteration's acceptance criterion: 'After picking a different region (e.g. Sydney via the picker), the ThisMonthCard updates: data-testid=home-thismonth-region shows the new region name and Set your region… link disappears.'

integration_issues.flow: ThisMonthCard column refresh on region change
integration_issues.issue: Because the React state never propagates (see above), the useEffect that depends on activeRegion?.name also doesn't refire, so the three guidance columns keep showing the OLD region's data (or the loading '…' state, depending on timing) until reload.

action_items: Fix useRegion cross-component sync: convert to a React context provider (e.g. <RegionProvider> at App root) OR subscribe to window 'storage' events OR adopt a tiny store (zustand/jotai). Then the ThisMonthCard, the Home header pill, and any other consumer will all update the instant the RegionPicker calls setRegion. This is required to meet the iteration's acceptance criterion.
Top up / rotate the Emergent LLM key — current usage 9.48 / 9.4 budget. Non-cached /api/guidance payloads currently 500. Only London/June (and previously-cached language variants) work.
critical_code_review_comments: useRegion (/app/frontend/src/hooks/useRegion.js): each consumer gets its own useState, so localStorage acts as a single-direction sink. Sibling components are not notified. Either expose via context or add a useSyncExternalStore subscribed to 'storage' events. Same anti-pattern likely affects useMyGarden if multiple components mutate it.

ThisMonthCard sets `error=true` then `if (error) return null` — silent failure. If the LLM budget is exhausted, the entire card disappears from Home with zero indication. Consider rendering a small fallback ('Couldn't load this month's preview — try the full guide') so users can still reach /calendar.

ThisMonthCard month dependency uses `new Date().getMonth()+1` captured at render time but never recomputed; in a long-lived SPA session that crosses midnight on month boundary the card silently shows stale month. Low priority.

useEffect in ThisMonthCard uses `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` to keep `plants` out of deps; that's OK because `gardenIds` derives from it, but the comment should explain the intent.
RegionPicker.jsx pick() reads `defaultRegion` from useRegion but never falls back to it on error — minor.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all card rendering & regressions pass; live region-update flow is broken)

seed_data_creation: Toggled localStorage keys patchpot.region.v1 and patchpot.lang.v1 during test; cleared between phases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Current month in test env is June (date 2026-06-16). London/June EN, DE, JA, ZH guidance payloads are cached in MongoDB and return instantly; French and uncached language/month/region combos currently 500 because the Emergent LLM key budget is exhausted (max 9.4, current 9.48). The ThisMonthCard expects activeRegion to flip live when the user picks a region — pre-existing useRegion hook design prevents this and is the only HIGH-priority frontend bug from this iteration. After a page reload, the card correctly shows the new region and hides the 'Set your region…' link. RegionPicker testids: region-picker-modal (container), region-search-input, region-results, region-result-{i}, region-detect-btn, region-default-btn, region-picker-close. data-testid for ThisMonthCard columns are .._plant, .._tasks, .._pests (not .._harvest).
rca of the issue: ThisMonthCard live-update bug: useRegion() in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useRegion.js creates an independent useState per call. Home.jsx, RegionPicker.jsx, and ThisMonthCard.jsx each instantiate the hook → each holds its own copy. When RegionPicker invokes setRegion(), only RegionPicker's local state and localStorage update; the other two components never receive the new value and don't re-render. Reproduction: 1) Load /, 2) click home-thismonth-set-region, 3) search 'Sydney', click region-result-0, 4) observe home-thismonth-region still says 'London, United Kingdom'. Verify localStorage.getItem('patchpot.region.v1') is the new Sydney object — confirms writes succeed. 5) Reload — card now shows Sydney correctly and the set-region link disappears. Mitigation: wrap consumers in a shared <RegionContext.Provider value={{ region, setRegion, clearRegion, defaultRegion }}> defined once in App.jsx, OR convert useRegion to useSyncExternalStore listening to a custom event dispatched on setRegion. After fix, the existing useEffect in ThisMonthCard (deps on activeRegion?.name) will refire and the guidance columns will refresh automatically.
